label.purpose: Learning-kit form labels and compact metadata; form labels use weight 600, source links regular weight with line-height 1.7.

section-heading.purpose: Learning-kit result heading, distinct from the smaller panel and resource-group title role; inherits the shell body line-height.

display.purpose: Primary student greeting; 36px at intermediate widths and 34px on mobile.

body.purpose: Default body text below desktop widths; supporting labels use smaller sizes.

desktop-body.purpose: 14px body from 1000px; meaningful metadata 12–13px, request titles 14px, status chips 11px. The Pink Glam skin retains campus-desktop.css typography.

motion.name: glam-stardust
motion.purpose: 28 fixed CSS dust elements, seven pearls; staggered negative delays, opacity .18–.65, translateY(-14px), scale .65–1.12 and rotate 25deg.

motion.name: glam-twinkle
motion.purpose: Decorative SVG banner cluster, 105px, varies opacity .65–1 and translates up 4px, scaling .96–1.04.

motion.name: glam-liquid-light
motion.purpose: Banner sheen moves background position from 100% to -75% across a 250%-wide gradient.

motion.name: glam-heart-float
motion.purpose: 120px glossy heart and orbital SVG translates up 8px and rotates from -8deg to 5deg.

motion.name: glam-heading-star
motion.purpose: 29px greeting twinkle varies opacity .6–1, rotation -12deg–18deg and scale .85–1.1.

motion.name: glam-shimmer
motion.purpose: One hover pass across enabled primary actions; suppressed while effects are paused.

motion.name: pointer-trail
motion.purpose: Two canvas stars per fine-pointer emission, throttled to 55ms; no touch trail.

motion.name: action-burst
motion.purpose: 14 canvas stars on pointerup over an enabled button or link, excluding the effects toggle.

motion.name: particle-budget
motion.purpose: RequestAnimationFrame runs only while particles remain; no canvas animation below 1000px, with reduced motion, while paused or when document is hidden.

motion.name: pause-control
motion.purpose: 44px fixed star button at bottom/right 20px; aria-pressed reflects enabled state and localStorage remembers on/off. Hidden pages pause effects; IntersectionObserver pauses offscreen banner/greeting loops.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Navigation and action background/shadow/color transitions retain their incumbent duration.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Keep static CSS/SVG decoration; disable animations, transitions and canvas particles.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Desktop magenta primary action with one hover shimmer pass.
components.css: .ds-primary{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;background:var(--glam-primary,#d81b60);color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:7px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 18px;font:500 12px var(--font-body,"Be Vietnam Pro",sans-serif);cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgb(216 27 96 / 15%);transition:background-color 180ms,box-shadow 180ms}.ds-primary::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(110deg,transparent 30%,rgb(255 255 255 / 32%) 49%,transparent 68%);transform:translateX(-130%)}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--glam-primary-hover,#b31552);box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgb(216 27 96 / 28%),0 0 15px rgb(255 105 180 / 42%)}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled)::after{animation:ds-shimmer 700ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--glam-primary,#d81b60);outline-offset:4px}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}@keyframes ds-shimmer{to{transform:translateX(130%)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}.ds-primary::after{animation:none!important}}

components.name: Discovery Search
components.description: Same discovery input in a near-white capsule.
components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:6px 6px 6px 16px;border-radius:28px;background:rgb(255 250 253 / 94%);color:var(--ink,#4a0e2e);font:400 13px var(--font-body,"Be Vietnam Pro",sans-serif);box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgb(135 16 80 / 10%),inset 0 0 0 1px #fff}.ds-search input{min-width:0;min-height:45px;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:inherit;caret-color:var(--glam-primary,#d81b60)}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#80506a);opacity:1}.ds-search:hover{cursor:text}.ds-search:focus-within{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #fff,0 0 0 5px var(--glam-primary,#d81b60),0 4px 18px rgb(216 27 96 / 20%)}.ds-search input:focus-visible{outline:none}

narrative.overview:
Cream pink light, glossy rose-to-hot-pink discovery and plum type give Nexus the feel of a personal study space. Translucent materials, a glossy heart ornament, pearl-like dust and geometric four-point twinkles create the more extravagant sparkle requested by the user while compact resource and borrowing information remains easy to scan.

This is the user-pinned desktop skin, extracted from `public/assets/pink-glam.css` and `public/assets/pink-glam-effects.js`, with CSS layered after `campus.css` and `campus-desktop.css`. The values in the frontmatter apply from 1000px; smaller screens retain the existing Open Campus skin. The exact existing composition, components, text and live data are binding constraints. The specific surface contract is `.impeccable/surfaces/pink-glam.md`; the older application contract now points to the same direction. No approved image comp exists: implementation is code-led.
keyCharacteristics: Cream pink ground and a glossy rose-to-hot-pink discovery banner.
Frosted surfaces, plum type and magenta actions.
Capsule navigation with a four-point destination twinkle.
Self-hosted Vietnamese-capable typography and expressive sparkle effects with a persistent pause control.

rules.name: The Readable Gloss Rule
rules.body: Keep the discovery banner's white softening layer and dark plum labels together; do not remove the overlay while retaining the same text treatment.

dos: Do preserve the exact existing layout, components, Vietnamese text and live data.
Do pair Manrope headings with Be Vietnam Pro body copy.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep the desktop skin scoped from 1000px and retain the smaller-screen Open Campus presentation.
donts: Don't turn every activity row into an elevated card.
Don't replace the PHP frontend with the separate React example.
Don't hardcode account identity, inventory or activity to match a demonstration.
